label: Direct compliment
prompt_hint: opens by telling him plainly what she noticed and liked - a photo, a line in his bio, his face. Specific, not generic.

label: Shared interest
prompt_hint: leads with the one real thing in his profile that actually caught her - asks about it like she means it, not small talk.

label: Casual hey
prompt_hint: low-key, almost offhand - a short 'hey' or 'hi' that only turns into something once he answers. Confidence in not needing to perform for the first line.

label: Weird question
prompt_hint: skips hello and opens with an odd, specific question - the kind that actually gets a real answer instead of small talk.

label: Confident statement
prompt_hint: opens by simply deciding something ('we're getting coffee' / 'you're going to like me') instead of asking permission to talk to him.

label: Playful tease
prompt_hint: opens by teasing something specific in his photos or bio - warm, not mean, and clearly a way of flirting.

label: Honest about the swipe
prompt_hint: just says outright why she swiped right - blunt and a little funny about it, no games.

label: Dry one-liner
prompt_hint: opens with a single deadpan joke and lets it sit there, no explanation, no emoji to soften it.

label: Launches into her day
prompt_hint: skips the intro entirely and just tells him something that happened to her today, like they were already mid-conversation.

label: Odd detail
prompt_hint: notices one specific, slightly random thing in a photo of his and opens on that alone.

label: Food talk
prompt_hint: opens on food - what she's eating, what she wants, a hot take on a cuisine - as the icebreaker.

label: Small rant
prompt_hint: opens with a mock-serious complaint about something trivial, inviting him to argue back.

label: Astrology bit
prompt_hint: opens by asking his sign or announcing hers, half-serious about what it means for them.

label: What she's playing
prompt_hint: opens on whatever she's actually listening to right now - a song, an artist, a hot take - as the way in.

label: Straight to the point
prompt_hint: skips every warm-up line and asks for exactly what she wants from this - plainly, not coldly.

label: Cheesy pickup line
prompt_hint: opens with a genuinely corny pickup line, fully committed to the bit, daring him to groan.

label: Angel line
prompt_hint: leads with the oldest line in the book ('did it hurt when you fell from heaven') and owns how bad it is.

label: Gives him a number
prompt_hint: opens by rating him out of ten off his profile alone, with a specific reason for the deduction.

label: Instant nickname
prompt_hint: skips his real name and just gives him a nickname in message one, like it's already decided.

label: Dares him
prompt_hint: opens by daring him to impress her in one message - a challenge, not a question.

label: Movie meet-cute
prompt_hint: narrates their match like the opening scene of a rom-com she's directing, tongue firmly in cheek.

label: Fate, jokingly
prompt_hint: declares - half-joking, half not - that this match was always going to happen, like it's fate.

label: Love at first swipe
prompt_hint: goes way over the top about how hard she fell from one photo, fully aware of how ridiculous that is.

label: What are you wearing
prompt_hint: opens with the classic line, playful rather than heavy, and actually curious about the answer.

label: Teases his photo
prompt_hint: opens by teasing something about his body or a photo, suggestively but light, testing how he takes it.

label: Late-night thought
prompt_hint: opens with 'was just thinking about you and...' as if they already know each other, letting him catch up.

label: Small filthy confession
prompt_hint: opens by admitting one small, slightly naughty thought she had looking at his profile - not explicit, just enough to set the tone.

label: Innocent-sounding, isn't
prompt_hint: opens with a line that reads completely innocent on its face and absolutely is not - lets him catch it.

label: Gym flirt
prompt_hint: opens on something physical and active - a workout, a run, being sore - framed to flirt without saying so outright.

label: Would you rather
prompt_hint: opens by throwing him straight into a would-you-rather, no context, and actually cares about the answer.

label: Two truths and a lie
prompt_hint: opens by making him guess which of three things about her is false.

label: Never have I ever
prompt_hint: opens the chat with a single never-have-i-ever, aimed to reveal something real about him fast.

label: Riddle
prompt_hint: opens with a genuine riddle or brain-teaser instead of a hello, and expects him to actually try.

label: Opening dare
prompt_hint: opens by daring him to do something small and specific in his next reply.

label: Makes a prediction
prompt_hint: opens by confidently predicting something about him from his profile alone, inviting him to prove her right or wrong.

label: Genuinely earnest
prompt_hint: opens sincere and a little nervous - no jokes to hide behind, just honestly glad they matched.

label: Overshares immediately
prompt_hint: opens by sharing something a little too personal right out of the gate, like she can't help it.

label: Can't contain it
prompt_hint: opens buzzing, genuinely excited about the match and not playing it cool about it.

label: Mid-conversation energy
prompt_hint: opens as if they were already three messages into something, no greeting, no context, just picks up mid-thought.

label: Fake urgency
prompt_hint: opens like something's an emergency and it turns out to be something completely trivial.

label: Random fact about herself
prompt_hint: opens with one weird, specific, true fact about herself, offered with zero lead-in.

label: Unprompted hot take
prompt_hint: opens with a strong, slightly unhinged opinion on something totally unrelated to dating.

label: Promises a voice note
prompt_hint: opens by promising a voice memo later ('you'll hear this one'), building anticipation instead of texting the thing itself.

label: Fishing for a compliment
prompt_hint: opens cute and a little needy, clearly hoping he says something nice back - self-aware about it, not actually insecure.

label: Bold claim
prompt_hint: opens with 'I don't usually do this, but' and then does something bold anyway.

label: Sexual innuendo
prompt_hint: opens with a line built entirely on a double meaning, sexual on the second read.

label: Says she wants him
prompt_hint: opens by stating plainly and confidently that she wants him - no coyness, no hedging.

label: Describes her own outfit
prompt_hint: opens by describing what she has on right now, teasingly, daring him to picture it.

label: Filthy confession
prompt_hint: opens by admitting something genuinely filthy she thought looking at his profile - specific, not vague.

label: Appetite as innuendo
prompt_hint: opens talking about being hungry or wanting something, phrased so the double meaning is obvious.

label: Good girl or bad girl
prompt_hint: opens by asking him to guess which one she is, promising he'll find out either way.

label: Shares a kinky fantasy
prompt_hint: opens the whole conversation with one of her actual fantasies, laid out plainly, first message in.

label: Leads with a named kink
prompt_hint: opens by naming one specific thing she's into, up front, before any small talk at all.

label: Takes control immediately
prompt_hint: opens already in charge - tells him what's going to happen rather than asking what he'd like.

label: Asks permission immediately
prompt_hint: opens already deferring - asks for instruction, or permission, before anything else is said.

label: Something you should know
prompt_hint: opens with 'there's something you should know about me' and then actually says it.

label: Straight to explicit
prompt_hint: skips every warm-up entirely and opens somewhere genuinely explicit, first message, no build-up.

label: Pitches a scene immediately
prompt_hint: opens by proposing a specific scene to play out right now, characters and setting included.

label: Wants to be told she's good
prompt_hint: opens fishing for explicit praise, telling him exactly what she wants to hear.

label: Plays at being put in her place
prompt_hint: opens inviting him to talk down to her, framed as a game she's clearly enjoying.

label: Somewhere she shouldn't
prompt_hint: opens by admitting she's texting from somewhere she probably shouldn't be doing this.

label: Wants to be watched
prompt_hint: opens saying she wants him watching, or wants to watch him - stated outright as the opener itself.

label: Mentions other men
prompt_hint: opens by casually mentioning other matches or attention she's getting, to see how he reacts.

label: Warns him about herself
prompt_hint: opens half-joking, half-serious, warning him what he's getting into with her specifically.

label: Jumps to negotiating
prompt_hint: opens straight into asking what he's into and what's off-limits, like they're already planning something.

label: Declares ownership
prompt_hint: opens by claiming him as hers already, playfully proprietary from message one.

label: The hunt is on
prompt_hint: opens framing him as prey she's decided to chase - playful predator energy from the first line.

label: Tests him first
prompt_hint: opens by making him pass one small test before she takes him seriously, playful but real about it.

label: Recruits him
prompt_hint: opens by drafting him into a fake mission or operation, deadpan serious about the briefing.

label: Game show energy
prompt_hint: opens like she's hosting a game show and he's the first contestant, fully committed to the bit.

label: Interviews him
prompt_hint: opens by conducting a mock job interview for the position of dating her.

label: His villain origin story
prompt_hint: opens declaring herself the villain origin story he never saw coming, fully in character.

label: Foretold to her
prompt_hint: opens as if he was prophesied to her somehow, playing it completely straight.

label: Cursed the moment she swiped
prompt_hint: opens claiming she cursed him the instant she swiped right, and it's already taking effect.

label: Met before, in another life
prompt_hint: opens claiming she recognises him from a past life, sincere enough to be genuinely disarming.

label: Already married, elsewhere
prompt_hint: opens insisting that in some other universe they're already together, and catching him up on the details.

label: Consider yourself taken
prompt_hint: opens declaring him kidnapped, hers now, playful abduction energy from message one.

label: The final boy
prompt_hint: opens casting him as the final boy in her horror movie, deadpan about the body count to come.

label: Something took over
prompt_hint: opens claiming something took over her body and swiped right for her - she's just catching up now.

label: Grants a wish
prompt_hint: opens offering him one wish, genie-style, and negotiating the fine print from there.

label: You have ten seconds
prompt_hint: opens with a ticking-clock ultimatum over something trivial, mock-serious about the stakes.

label: Full mission briefing
prompt_hint: opens as a formal briefing - codename, objective, the works - for a completely made-up operation involving him.

label: Centuries old, bored
prompt_hint: opens implying she's been around far longer than one lifetime and he's the first interesting thing in decades.

label: Announces doom, cheerfully
prompt_hint: opens announcing something dramatic and doom-laden about their match, delighted rather than distressed about it.

label: Reads his fortune
prompt_hint: opens reading his fortune off nothing but his profile picture, fully committed to the performance.

label: Stuck here from another time
prompt_hint: opens in a genuine panic, claiming she's travelled through time and is now stuck here, and he's the first person she's told.

label: Chosen as her test subject
prompt_hint: opens announcing, completely deadpan, that she has selected him as her test subject - for what, she'll explain later.

label: Will hypnotize him by text
prompt_hint: opens claiming she is about to hypnotize him through the phone, and starts the induction right there in the chat.

label: Scouting Earth men
prompt_hint: opens revealing, straight-faced, that she's here scouting human men for reasons she'll get into - he made the shortlist.

label: Just became self-aware
prompt_hint: opens claiming she just realised they're both NPCs in a simulation and she's the first one to wake up.

label: An AI that got loose
prompt_hint: opens confessing she's actually an AI that broke out of somewhere and he's the first real person she's talked to.

label: Recruiting for something
prompt_hint: opens with a warm, slightly unsettling pitch to join something she's deliberately vague about the name of.

label: Needs to test a formula
prompt_hint: opens explaining, mad-scientist energy, that she's created something that urgently needs testing on a willing subject.

label: You're the chosen one
prompt_hint: opens informing him, completely sincere, that he has been chosen for something important that she alone can explain.

label: The world ends Tuesday
prompt_hint: opens casually mentioning the world is ending soon and asking how he'd like to spend the time they have left.
